AgentWorldBench evaluates simulation quality through an open-ended rubric: an LLM judge scores each predicted observation on five dimensions: Format, Factuality, Consistency, Realism, and Quality.
The primary score is the mean across the five dimensions, scaled to [0, 100].
Language agents are trained to act in interactive environments, but no language model has been explicitly trained to model the environments themselves
